title: Restriction naturality of the existing normalized tensor-resolution coordinates
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], M,N quasi-coherent module sheaves [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and choose affine coefficient modules MA_U,NA_U, section equivalences sM_U,sN_U and projective resolutions P_U. Let K,F be K-flat complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex] with quasi-isomorphisms q:K -> M[0], s:F -> N[0] [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. For n>=0, use the existing tensorResolutionCoordinateSections c_U:H_n(P_U tensor NA_U) -> Gamma(U,H^{-n}(Tot(K tensor N[0]))) [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology]. For any affine inclusion V subset U with restriction phi, let b:NA_U -> NA_V be phi-semilinear, a:P_U -> Res_phi(P_V) and k:P_U tensor NA_U -> Res_phi(P_V tensor NA_V) chain maps. If sM_V(pi_V(a_0 x))=res_M(sM_U(pi_U x)), sN_V(b y)=res_N(sN_U y), and k_j(x tensor y)=a_j(x) tensor b(y), then res(c_U x)=c_V(e(H_n(k)(x))) for every x, where e is the exact restriction-of-scalars homology comparison. This equation concerns the fixed constructed coordinates and requires no choice of comparison witnesses.

proof.text: Apply affine tensor-homology naturality using hb and hk, and common K-flat comparison naturality using ha. Compose the two squares using functoriality and associativity; this is the direct associativity calculation in the proof.
Rewrite the canonical coordinate isomorphisms using their factorization formula.

Apply naturality of the affine associated-sheaf sections unit and restriction adjunction, implemented by tensorResolutionSection_naturality. The map on coefficient homology is H_n(k) followed by exact restriction-of-scalars homology, so this is the required equation on sections.

theorem tensorResolutionCoordinateSections_naturality
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (M N : Y.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    (MA NA : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, ModuleCat.{u} (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u))
    (sM : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, MA U ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, U.1)] M.val.obj (op U.1))
    (sN : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, NA U ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, U.1)] N.val.obj (op U.1))
    (P : ∀ U, ProjectiveResolution (MA U))
    (K F : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ)
    (q : K ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj M)
    (s : F ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj N)
    (hK : CochainComplex.IsKFlatTensor (R := Y.sheaf) K)
    (hF : CochainComplex.IsKFlatTensor (R := Y.sheaf) F)
    (hq : QuasiIso q) (hs : QuasiIso s) (n : ℕ)
    (V U : Y.affineOpens) (h : V.1 ≤ U.1)
    (b : NA U →ₛₗ[(Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom] NA V)
    (a : (P U).complex ⟶ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
      (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj
        (P V).complex)
    (k : ((tensorRight (NA U)).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj (P U).complex ⟶
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.down ℕ)).obj
        (((tensorRight (NA V)).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj (P V).complex))
    (ha : ∀ x : (P U).complex.X 0,
      sM V ((P V).π.f 0 (a.f 0 x)) =
        M.val.map (homOfLE h).op (sM U ((P U).π.f 0 x)))
    (hb : ∀ y : NA U,
      sN V (b y) = N.val.map (homOfLE h).op (sN U y))
    (hk : ∀ (j : ℕ) (x : (P U).complex.X j) (y : NA U),
      k.f j (x ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, U.1)] y) =
        (show (P V).complex.X j from a.f j x) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, V.1)] (b y)) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory Y.sheaf
    let Q := (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor K
      ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj N)
      (curriedTensor Y.Modules)).homology (-(n : ℤ))
    let e := (((tensorRight (NA V)).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj
      (P V).complex).sc n |>.mapHomologyIso
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom)
    ∀ x, Q.val.map (homOfLE h).op
        (tensorResolutionCoordinateSections Y M N U (MA U) (NA U)
          (sM U) (sN U) (P U) K F q s hK hF hq hs n x) =
      tensorResolutionCoordinateSections Y M N V (MA V) (NA V)
        (sM V) (sN V) (P V) K F q s hK hF hq hs n
        (e.hom (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap k n x))
